The '''1955–56 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by six points over nearest rival [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Stirling Albion F.C.|Stirling Albion]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1956–57 Scottish Division Two]].

==League reconstruction==
Following league reconstruction, League Division One (known until then as Division A) was expanded from 16 to 18 teams this season with Airdrieonians and Dunfermline Athletic being promoted from the previous season with all Division A teams staying up.
